items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: I don't think I know him. ... And she met a little guy, a little pimp, his name was Jimmy Monroe... I think that was his name.

ctx.x: Archie Savage... I don't think I know him. I knew a...I knew an awful lot of guys. I knew this one guy that...

Lady Day fell for a guy out there. When she first came out there, she... Of course, she was alone. And everybody expected her to team up with Lester Young right away. That was taken for granted. But that didn't happen. And it was like Howdy-Doody time. It was real funny; it was such a surprise! And she went for the other tenor player, Bumps. And he started foolin' around with her, she went with him for a little while. Then she met a little guy, a little pimp, his name was Jimmy Monroe... I think that was his name.
